## Guidelines for Formatting Markdown
1. Two lines between H1 and H2 headers if there is not any content in between.
2. One line between H2, H3, H4, etc. headers if there is not any content in between.
3. No lines between headers and content.
4. One line between paragraphs.
5. Add a single empty line at the end of the markdown content.
6. No lines before tables, lists, callouts or code blocks.
7. One line after tables, lists, callouts or code blocks.
